bf12e3067ea092b5d84936cf5884cf8823b08b42.answer: You can take up to a total of 26 workweeks of unpaid leave during a "single 12-month period" to care for your son if he is a covered servicemember with a serious injury or illness [C104]. To be eligible, you must be the spouse, son, daughter, parent, or next of kin of the servicemember [C104]. However, you are limited to a combined total of 26 workweeks of leave for any FMLA-qualifying reasons during this single 12-month period [C1].
